## Summary
This PR introduces a GitHub Actions workflow to build and deploy the Compose Web sample app to Netlify.

[![Preview Screenshot](https://i9.ytimg.com/vi/sJio81gll8U/mqdefault.jpg?sqp=CMjq6c0G-oaymwEmCMACELQB8quKqQMa8AEB-AH-CYACzAWKAgwIABABGGUgZShlMA8=&rs=AOn4CLC_LAJYqaA9qFIiLgaRaM7cg1HcCg)](https://youtu.be/sJio81gll8U)

## Changes
- Added workflow file `.github/workflows/deploy-netlify.yml`
- Configured release event trigger (`on: release: types: [published]`)
- Set `production-deploy: true` to push directly to production
- Secured Netlify credentials via GitHub secrets (`NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN`, `NETLIFY_SITE_ID`)

## Netlify Setup
- Get OAuth from User settings 
- Get Project Id / Site Id 
- Add both as Secrets in GitHub settings

## Testing
- Verified successful deploy on release event
- Confirmed production site updates correctly
- [Live Test Site](https://calf-webapp.netlify.app)
